article.title: Open Benchmark Evaluates AI Thermal Models for 2.5D and 3D ICs (UTS, TU Munich, ShanghaiTech)
article.summary: Researchers at the University of Technology Sydney, ShanghaiTech University, and Technical University of Munich published a technical paper titled “IC-ThermBench: An Open, Progressive Benchmark for Generalizable 2.5D/3D-IC Thermal Learning.” Abstract Excerpt: “We introduce IC-ThermBench, an open and progressive benchmark that combines established 3D-IC steady-state, transient, and industrial package tasks with a new 50,000-sample 2.5D chiplet extension designed to evaluate progressively broader represented physical variation and cross-package OOD transfer. ” Find the technical paper here . August 2026. Hang, David, Wenkai Yang, Kuiye Ding, Haiyang Xin, and Jacky Wei. “IC-ThermBench: An Open, Progressive Benchmark for Generalizable 2.5D/3D-IC Thermal Learning.” arXiv preprint arXiv:2608.239

article.title: Googlebook is finally official with 5 flagship Android-powered laptops starting at $899
article.summary: TL;DR Google has now fully launched its new Android-powered Googlebook platform. Acer, ASUS, Dell, Lenovo, and HP have also announced premium Googlebook laptops starting at $899. The first Googlebooks will go on sale in the US on October 4, with pre-orders now open across the Google Store, Best Buy, and select retailers. Google is officially entering a new chapter in the laptop market with the Googlebook platform finally going mainstream after months of anticipation, leaks, and teasers. What we’ve known so far as Google’s Aluminium OS finally has an official name: Googlebook OS. Built on the Android technology stack with foundations from Chrome OS , the new platform is designed to turn a premium laptop into a true companion for your Android phone .

article.title: Pixel 11 battery drain could have an unexpected culprit: Your Wi-Fi router
article.summary: TL;DR Some Pixel 11 owners are reporting excessive idle battery drain, with Wi-Fi showing unusually high battery usage. A detailed test found that certain routers repeatedly woke the phone, preventing it from sleeping properly. Switching to Wi-Fi 5 or another router dramatically improved battery life, but the exact cause remains unconfirmed. Pixel owners are no strangers to battery-life complaints , and Google’s Tensor era has had its share of heat, modem, and efficiency problems. The Pixel 11 series looked like a step forward, especially with its new MediaTek modem, but some owners are now chasing a different kind of drain. article.title: AWS open-sources an AI agent it says is 45% cheaper than Claude Code and Codex
article.summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is lifting the lid on a new open source, general-purpose AI agent, designed to give developers a ready-made foundation they can run locally or deploy to the cloud. Strands Harness, as it’s called, builds on Strands Agents , which AWS debuted in May 2025 as an open source Python SDK for building AI agents. Strands takes what AWS calls a “model-driven approach”: developers provide the model, tools and instructions, while the model determines how to tackle the task and when to call those tools. AWS later brought Strands to TypeScript , and in February created Strands Labs as a separate home for more experimental projects. article.title: Google Takes on Apple, Microsoft With AI-Powered Laptops
article.summary: Google is taking another shot at the premium laptop market with its Googlebooks, priced at $899 and built around Gemini AI and with tighter integration with Android phones. Sameer Samat, president of the Android Ecosystem at Google, explains why the company combined elements of Android and ChromeOS for the new experience and how some of the new features are designed to challenge Apple and Microsoft in the AI PC race. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

article.title: Startups Like Harvey Embrace Open Models to Cut Reliance on Anthropic, OpenAI
article.summary: The $15.6 billion legal startup Harvey built its business around training AI models like OpenAI’s GPT-4 to do specialized work for lawyers. Recently, however, soaring artificial intelligence costs have nudged it to rethink its dependence on the AI giants.
